queries.label: Plate Appearance Quality
queries.claim: One PAQ-1.0 row per plate appearance on a baseball-style .000-1.000 scale, combining authoritative MLB outcome, bounded grind, and situational evidence; every component remains visible and the rating is derived, not asserted.

queries.label: Long and difficult plate appearances
queries.claim: A transparent exploratory PA score computed from mapped pitch, swing, contact, and foul counts.

queries.label: Swing-to-result conversion
queries.claim: Observed pitch, swing, contact, terminal-contact, hit, and out conversion by batter.

queries.label: Whiffs and takes
queries.claim: Mapped swings without contact and pitches without swings, bounded by direct-mapping coverage.

queries.label: Batter-pitcher matchups
queries.claim: Explicit event and PA-result evidence for each observed batter-pitcher pairing.

queries.label: Non-hit productive plate appearances
queries.claim: Non-hit PAs associated with an explicit safe advance or run by another runner; not official RBI attribution.

queries.label: Contact outcomes
queries.claim: Mapped terminal contact chains grouped by their explicit institutional result.

queries.label: Half-inning rally breakdown
queries.claim: Explicit batting and runner-event composition within each mapped half inning.

queries.label: Game action per minute
queries.claim: Mapped domain-event counts normalized by the recorded game temporal interval.

queries.label: Official scorer decisions
queries.claim: Explicit official-scorer judgment types and judged processes.

queries.label: Umpire pitch calls
queries.claim: On-field umpire pitch calls separated from operative replay calls, with affirming or overturning review outcomes.

queries.label: Replay review outcomes
queries.claim: Explicit on-field decision, optional challenge, replay-review act, replay decision, review result, and final structured play or pitch outcome; unsupported decision families remain visibly unclassified.

queries.label: Players with every hit type
queries.claim: Players observed with all four explicit hit-result classes in the selected corpus.

queries.label: Runner destinations
queries.claim: Safe and run destinations evidenced by BaseTouchingProcess participants and successors.

queries.label: Stolen-base attempt results
queries.claim: Mapped StealAttemptAct outcomes with unresolved attempts exposed rather than treated as failures.

queries.label: Games with contact but no positive result
queries.claim: Contact games lacking reviewed positive contact contribution evidence, within the mapped result vocabulary.

queries.label: Mapped play-data checks
queries.claim: Structural defects and generic-only terminal outcome gaps in mapped event-to-result-to-adjudication chains; every returned row is a finding.

blockedAnalytics.reason: No reviewed score-state and expectancy model is represented in the RDF.
Coordinate sites exist, but numeric coordinate values are not mapped.
RBI, earned-run, and left-on-base continuity are not fully represented.
The current counted-foul mapping is not a complete pitch-by-pitch count-state model.
